purpose: Five non-random grading calibration cases, not a retrieval benchmark score.

api_700_followup.method: Same public inputs, 700-character chunks, overlap 100 and top five; enable API vector retrieval plus existing keyword/RRF path. No reranking or contextual enrichment.
api_700_followup.conclusion: Actual API hybrid execution verified. No support-grade improvement on the five calibration cases; interpretability still missing. No overall quality or model-superiority claim. Full support review and stage-level failure diagnosis remain. Production defaults unchanged.

rubric.full: Retrieved top-five evidence explicitly supports every listed required claim, allowing paraphrases and evidence across passages.
rubric.partial: At least one but not every required claim is supported.
rubric.scope: Support for the reference answer, not generated-answer correctness. Claim requirements are manual calibration judgments, not a blind holdout. No aggregate quality estimate is warranted.

required_claims: Previously generated symbols become additional input for generating the next symbol.
Perplexity worsens because the model is less certain.
Large dot-product magnitudes put softmax in a region of very small gradients.
Individual attention heads exhibit distinct tasks related to syntactic and semantic structure.
They may permit extrapolation to sequences longer than those encountered during training.
